lessons: CRITICAL fixed: the special-leave section stated the 30 abroad-visit days were a ONE-TIME entitlement across full service; kolzchut confirms they are per service year (annual). Only the funded flight is once-in-service. Inverted claim corrected in EN + HE + checklist.

MAJOR fixed: combat/combat-support boded supplements were guessed (~422/~370); official IDF figures are 467.2 (combat, level א'+) / 233.7 (combat-support, level א') NIS/month. Added base grant 601.2 NIS/month.

MAJOR added: Aliyah-Ministry monthly grant for olim bodedim = 100% of a private base salary (150% for Ethiopian olim within 10y), STACKS on the IDF grant (kolzchut) - a high-value benefit the skill omitted.
MAJOR added: Step 5.5 with often-missed benefits (psychometric-course funding, private-work permit, subsidized אל"ח/'יחד למען החייל' apartments, קרן הישג/קרן גרוס scholarships, כנפיים program).

META-LESSON on flights: the first research pass could NOT source the '1 non-combat / 2 combat / after 8 months' framing and I wrongly softened it to 'once during service' AND wrongly stated medical insurance is the soldier's responsibility. The Judge caught it: kolzchut מימון טיסה confirms non-combat=1, combat=2 (not same year), after 8 months, and the funding COVERS ticket + port fees + medical insurance (soldier pays only passport + entry visas). Restored the correct sourced facts across body, metadata, checklist, evidence. Lesson: an absent source from ONE research pass is not disproof; verify against the dedicated kolzchut page before softening a specific claim.

MAJOR fixed HE parity gaps present since creation: HE was missing Step 8.5 entirely (arnona/electricity/bank-account/pre-discharge interview), the HE Step 2 form flow presented Form 7304 as the pre-enlistment soldier form (wrong; Form 62 is the soldier-facing form for both phases), and HE Step 3 omitted the combat supplement.

CRITICAL fixed: Form 62 and Form 7304 were assigned to the WRONG phases since the 1.1.0 cycle. Kolzchut הגשת בקשה להכרה כחייל בודד is explicit: a pre-enlistment candidate fills 7304 at the Rakezet Tash's initiative; a serving soldier fills 62 in the unit. The old text also told users NOT to ask for 7304 at the counter, which is the exact opposite of the process. Corrected in EN, HE, recognition-process.md and domain-checklist.md.

CRITICAL fixed: the skill implied there is no outer deadline on the Pikadon once the 5-year restricted phase ends. hachvana states the realization window was extended from 7 to 10 years from discharge for ALL soldiers discharged after 12.7.2007. Added, and flagged as universal rather than a boded benefit.

CRITICAL fixed: the funded-flight and 30-abroad-visit-day benefits are gated on being a boded 'מובהק' (parents abroad / emigrated / on shlichut >= 6 months). The skill presented one flat package to all three recognition tracks, so an estrangement-track soldier would have been told they get flights they cannot get.

CRITICAL fixed: the flight cap was stated as if it capped all travel abroad. Added an explicit carve-out routing a bereavement or critical-illness case to Mashak Tash and the Aguda rather than answering 'nothing remains'.

CRITICAL treated: neither the active-duty rent participation nor the Aliyah-Ministry grant has a published backdating rule or application deadline. Rather than invent one, the skill now instructs the agent to refuse to answer either way and to give the safe operational version (file as soon as the entitlement exists).

SCRIPT BUGS fixed (three): negative/zero rent produced a negative entitlement; the first-installment line printed 6,000 NIS while the total was 0 when fewer than 6 months were eligible; and the 30-day-month approximation undercounted, so the example command in SKILL.md returned 11 months against the skill's own stated 12. Now validated input, clamped installments, exact calendar-month arithmetic, and a new --rent-months flag so a short lease is not overstated.

EVIDENCE: 15 of 43 citations were authored paraphrases or pointed at pages that did not contain the text (two cited a kolzchut portal page with zero occurrences of the topic). All repaired with text copied from the live pages; --check-sources now reports 33 verified, 0 failed.

HE/EN contradiction fixed: SKILL_HE.md said the estrangement track gets the same package as an oleh, which its own Step 3 refuted (no sal klita, no Aliyah-Ministry grant). Also removed the HE-only claim that the grant 'doubles' income, which the EN Gotchas explicitly refute for a lochem.
